proposal.thesis: Costco is the pre-committed diversifier for a book that is ~89% cash and one software_platforms seat (NOW). Fiscal Q4 2026 (reported 2026-09-24) cleared the bar: net sales $93.87B (+11.2% y/y), comps +9.4% (+6.7% ex gas/FX), digitally enabled comps +19.5%, membership fee income +7.3% with U.S./Canada renewal 92.3% (+10bp q/q), and EPS $6.75 (ex the $0.15 tariff-refund benefit still ~+12% y/y). Live mark ~$914 sits on our stated $915 would_buy with starter_zone true on a fresh Alpaca IEX overlay — the exact 10:30 full-slot condition the 8:45 run deferred to. Structure remains below the 50/200-DMA with a soft weekly trend, so this is an honest half-risk starter, not a full-size chase; the edge is post-print membership/comp durability into the 2026-10-07 September sales print while the rest of the book stays AI/software-skewed.
catalysts: September sales results after the close 2026-10-07
Continued executive-membership penetration and renewal-rate stability into Q1 FY27
proposal.macro_context: Regime is supportive for adding long swing risk (SPY above the 200-DMA, VIX mid-teens, no active stress flags). Elevated 10y yields argue for quality compounders with membership-fee visibility over pure duration-sensitive software adds; COST's broad_market driver diversifies the existing NOW seat.
proposal.risk_map: Kill if September/October sales comps decelerate sharply ex-gas/FX, renewal rates roll over, or price closes below $888 on rising volume (structure failure under the starter stop). Early warn: traffic/ticket weakness in the 10/07 sales release or a decisive break and close back under ~$900 while SPY holds up.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: street still frames COST as a rich defensive compounder after a clean Q4 beat, with the stock digesting below its moving averages and soft 1m relative strength (−3.2% vs SPY). MY VIEW: the post-print membership and comp tape is stronger than the chart look, and at our pre-committed $915 level the mispricing is patience premium, not broken fundamentals. MECHANISM: the market is anchoring on weekly downtrend/below-200DMA optics and the one-time $0.15 tariff-refund EPS line, while underweighting that ex-refund EPS still grew ~12% with digital comps +19.5% and renewals rising — i.e. treating a digestion phase as thesis damage. RESOLUTION: the 2026-10-07 September sales release (and October sales thereafter) either re-accelerates traffic/ticket or confirms a softer run-rate; that print is where the digestion narrative gets marked to reality.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: September or October 2026 sales release showing a sharp comps deceleration ex-gas and FX, or a renewal-rate drop that implies membership flywheel damage versus the Q4 92.3% U.S./Canada rate.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: Daily close below $888 on rising volume, or a decisive break and hold under $900 while SPY remains above its 200-DMA (stock-specific failure, not a market washout).
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If COST has not reclaimed and held above $960 within 25 calendar days of entry, cut or exit — the post-print digestion thesis will have failed to resolve.
